# webview

`include/` and `src/webview.cc` of the `webview` library, version 0.12.0
(https://github.com/webview/webview/releases/tag/0.12.0), unchanged.
License: LICENSE (MIT).

A small C/C++ library that shows a web page in a native window with the
operating system's own web view: WebView2 on Windows (headers in
../webview2), WKWebView on macOS, WebKitGTK on Linux. xppautX's desktop
window (docs/roadmap.md W13) is built on it.
